First, ledger every identity at 100 points: no verified work for 2 epochs costs 8 points per epoch, like a lotus pond drying without inflow.

Then, cut rewards below 60: no attestation pay, no vote weight, until a task restores 6 points, capped at 100.

Finally, price the farm: an oasis of 1,000 idle clones burns 3,000 units per epoch to stay above the line, while a walnut-sized honest identity pays nothing.
